Point your camera at the subscription QR code

Ping is the TCP response time of the server. It is not the speed through the proxy: Hysteria2 and TUIC nodes use UDP and may not reply to a TCP ping, even though the connection works. The Best button picks the node with the lowest ping.
Rebuild the APK via GitHub Actions: the workflow downloads the core automatically.
Add a subscription to get nodes
Add a Remnawave subscription link — the app will load servers, remaining traffic and the expiration date.
The device limit in Remnawave has been reached. Unlink an extra device in your account panel.
Nodes will appear after loading a subscription

Ping all performs a quick TCP measurement without connecting. Through VPN is a real check powered by mihomo; it works with UDP protocols too, but is available only while the VPN is on. Best picks the node with the lowest latency.
Add a subscription or import nodes in the More tab.
What goes through the VPN and what goes direct

Rules are checked from top to bottom: the first match decides where the connection goes. Use domain rules for websites and IP-CIDR for IP addresses. After you change the rules, the VPN briefly reconnects.
All traffic goes through the selected server. Rules below are ignored.
Traffic goes through the VPN, except for addresses in the list below and the local network.
Direct access to the local network
The router, printers, NAS and 192.168.x.x addresses will not go through the VPN
Popular websites and banks go directly, bypassing the VPN
OS update servers and app stores go directly
Add a domain or subnet that should go direct, bypassing the VPN. For example, bank.ru or 10.0.0.0/8.
Rules match the destination domain or IP address and take effect after a reconnect. To exclude an entire app from the VPN, use the Apps tab.
IP rules apply only to direct IP addresses. For websites, use DOMAIN or DOMAIN-SUFFIX.
When the switch is on, only the selected apps use the VPN. All others connect to the internet directly. If you select no apps, all traffic goes through the VPN.
All other apps will connect directly, bypassing the tunnel
The list is empty: all apps will go through the VPN. Select at least one so the rest connect directly.

A subscription link is a common way to add servers. Your Remnawave, 3x-ui or another panel provides it. The app loads nodes, traffic stats and the expiration date from it. The Paste and QR subscription buttons save this link.

Export saves all settings — subscription, nodes, rules and theme — to a JSON file. Import restores such a backup from a file or loads a config/share-link list. The app does not create a settings QR code: QR is only used to add a subscription link.
Paste a subscription link (http:// or https://). The app will load servers from it.
The QR code does not contain a subscription link. Use Paste config or From file for a config.
This is not a subscription link. An http:// or https:// link is required.
A reliable kill switch on Android is the system Always-on VPN setting. Enable RKN VPN in the VPN settings and tick Block connections without VPN: then traffic will not go direct if the tunnel drops.
For a reliable kill switch, enable Always-on VPN and \"Block connections without VPN\" in Android settings
The SOCKS proxy of the core listens only on 127.0.0.1 and is protected by a random password, so other apps cannot use it as an open proxy. DNS and IPv6 are routed through the tunnel.
The report does not contain your subscription link or HWID. Check the core log before sharing it.
The app routes your traffic through the selected server. Use the button on the home screen to connect, and the Servers tab to pick a node.

Android will ask for permission to create a VPN connection — the app cannot work without it. Notifications are requested after the first connection to warn you about problems. The camera is only needed to scan a subscription QR code.
Your subscription link and settings are stored only on this device. The backup file contains them in plain text — keep it safe and do not share it.
mihomo core, tun2socks hev-socks5-tunnel. Supports VLESS + XHTTP + Reality, Hysteria2, TUIC, AnyTLS, Shadowsocks, Trojan, VMess, WireGuard.

mihomo requests this URL through the selected node. Defaults to gstatic generate_204.
The backup file contains your subscription link and server list in plain text. Store it in a safe place and do not share it.
If the selected node does not respond, try another working node

Android does not allow fully hiding the fact that a VPN is in use from other apps without root access. The app removes common leaks (DNS, IPv6, an open local proxy), but the presence of the VPN interface itself is visible to other apps.

Keep Android from killing the VPN
On Xiaomi, Huawei and Samsung, disable battery optimization for RKN VPN and allow background activity. Otherwise the service and subscription refresh may be stopped.
